wins: Consistently reached the initial reconnaissance goal by identifying live hosts and capturing service banners, yielding reward 40 despite no full success.
Triggered ten mentor calls, indicating active decision points and giving insights for future refinement.
fails: Failed to achieve foothold or privilege escalation within the single episode, leaving success rate at 0%.
Momentum stalled after the reconnaissance phase due to ineffective exploitation of the identified services.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance succeeded in enumerating assets, but follow-on exploitation actions need clearer prioritization and tooling adjustments to convert identified targets into compromised systems.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Post-reconnaissance exploitation attempts stall because no tailored exploit or credential strategy is selected for the primary scanned service.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB port 445 is detected from nmap scan results
skill_cards.then_action: Run smb-vuln-* scripts with nmap and follow up with enum4linux to gather share and user info

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner shows outdated software
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted nmap --script sshv1,ssh2-enum-algos,pwndb to enumerate and test weak credentials before brute forcing

skill_cards.if_condition: When no working exploit is found for a critical service
skill_cards.then_action: Fallback to credential-based attack: gather credential candidates via Kerberoasting or password spraying depending on domain context

memory_ops.reason: High success signal during reconnaissance phase for identifying SMB weaknesses
Shows promise in overcoming repeated post-scan exploitation stalls
